\chapter{Hardware}
\label{ch:hardware}

\section{Sensors}
Each node carries two capacitive sensors at depths of 10 and 30 centimetres,
a microcontroller and a radio. Figure~\ref{fig:setup} shows one node before
it went into the ground.

\begin{figure}[ht]
  \centering
  \includegraphics[width=0.4\textwidth]{graphics/setup}
  \caption{A sensor node.}
  \label{fig:setup}
\end{figure}

\section{Calibration}
Raw readings depend on temperature and on the soil itself. We fitted a
straight line from raw counts to volumetric water content for each sensor,
using samples dried in an oven as the reference.
